lines.cap: She was the first living thing to orbit the Earth. And she was never coming back.
lines.say: She was the first living thing to orbit the Earth. And she was never coming back.

lines.cap: Moscow, 1957. Scientists pick a small stray dog off the streets. Her name is Laika.
lines.say: Moscow, 1957. Scientists pick a small stray dog off the streets. Her name is Laika.

lines.cap: Strays were tough, used to cold and hunger. Perfect, they thought, for space.
lines.say: Strays were tough, used to cold and hunger. Perfect, they thought, for space.

lines.cap: She trained in tiny cages, and in machines that shook like a rocket.
lines.say: She trained in tiny cages, and in machines that shook like a rocket.

lines.cap: On the third of November, Sputnik 2 launches, with Laika inside.
lines.say: On the third of November, Sputnik 2 launches, with Laika inside.

lines.cap: She becomes the first animal ever to orbit the Earth.
lines.say: She becomes the first animal ever to orbit the Earth.

lines.cap: But there was no way to bring her back. Decades later, the world learned she died within hours, from the heat.
lines.say: But there was no way to bring her back. Decades later, the world learned she died within hours, from the heat.

lines.cap: One of the scientists later said, we did not learn enough to justify the death of the dog.
lines.say: One of the scientists later said, we did not learn enough to justify the death of the dog.

lines.cap: Today, a monument to Laika stands in Moscow. A small dog, on top of a rocket.
lines.say: Today, a monument to Laika stands in Moscow. A small dog, on top of a rocket.
